summary: Formalized architectural governance by integrating structural integrity frameworks (DAG-based modeling, AST-based rationale) with the Semantic Novelty Guardrail (SNG) to ensure long-term reliability and expansive growth. This dual approach enforces architectural intent through automated validation while quantifying the distance between new proposals and historical successes to prevent iterative stagnation.
key_learnings: PEP 487 and structural hashing provide robust defense against state-space ambiguity.
Representing knowledge as a DAG prevents cognitive overload by enforcing foundational mastery.
Semantic cache decay and automated integrity checks are essential to prevent signal degradation.
Decoupling relationship metadata via Edge Tables and materialized indices optimizes recursive traversal performance.
Novelty scoring balances semantic divergence with utility-weighted success metrics to ensure growth remains expansive.
A persistent vector store of architectural summaries is essential for maintaining long-term solution space exploration.
